tasks.title: Project scaffolding, environment configuration, and test infrastructure
tasks.description: Create project configuration, dependency definitions, and automated testing fixtures. Generate .gitignore ignoring virtual environments, caches, .env files, build artifacts, data/output/, assets/charts/, and generated PDFs. Generate .env.example with default environment variables (APP_ENV, LOG_LEVEL, DATA_DIR, OUTPUT_DATA_DIR, CHART_ASSETS_DIR, OUTPUT_PDF_PATH, FURNITURE_MOM_FLUCTUATION_THRESHOLD, TOP_STATES_COUNT). Create requirements.txt with pinned production and test dependencies (pandas>=2.0.0, numpy>=1.24.0, openpyxl>=3.1.0, fpdf2>=2.7.0, matplotlib>=3.7.0, pytest>=7.4.0). Setup src/__init__.py, tests/__init__.py, and tests/conftest.py with synthetic test fixtures for orders, order details, and sales targets.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.1, AC-E4: Pytest discovers test fixtures via conftest.py with `python -m pytest`; .gitignore ignores virtualenvs, build artifacts, .env, and caches; .env.example defines all configuration defaults.

tasks.title: Data ingestion and schema normalization module (DataLoader)
tasks.description: Implement DataLoader in src/data_loader.py to ingest List of Orders.xlsx, Order Details.xlsx, and Sales target.xlsx. Normalize column names to lowercase snake_case, strip whitespace, and coerce heterogeneous date formats (DD-MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, Excel serials) into pandas datetime objects. Cast numeric columns (amount, profit, quantity, target) to float64 or int64. Validate records using dataclasses (RawOrderRecord, RawOrderDetailRecord, RawSalesTargetRecord) and raise descriptive FileNotFoundError or ValueError when files or mandatory columns are missing. Create tests/test_data_loader.py with unit tests covering successful loads, date coercion, type casting, and schema validation error handling.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.1, AC-E1, AC-E4: A test suite in tests/test_data_loader.py checks that raw Excel files are ingested, column names normalized, mixed date formats parsed to datetime, numeric fields typed, and descriptive exceptions raised for missing or corrupt files (`pytest tests/test_data_loader.py -v`).

tasks.title: Order dataset merging & Question 1 Part 1 Category Sales & Profitability analysis
tasks.description: Implement AnalyticsEngine in src/analytics_engine.py with merge_orders() and compute_category_performance(). merge_orders() performs an inner join on order_id between normalized orders and order details, preserving line items and logging cardinality. compute_category_performance() groups by category to calculate total sales, total profit, order-level category average profit (grouped by (order_id, category) then averaged across distinct orders containing that category), and profit margin percentage ((Total Profit / Total Amount) * 100). Preserves negative profits for loss-making items and provides zero-division safety. Returns List[CategoryPerformance]. Implement unit tests in tests/test_analytics_engine.py checking join semantics, margin math, order-level average profit, and negative profit retention.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.2, AC-1.3, AC-E2, AC-E5, AC-E6: Pytest in tests/test_analytics_engine.py::test_category_performance checks inner join cardinality, preserves negative profit line items, computes category total sales, total profit, order-level category average profit grouped by (Order ID, Category), and computes profit margin % with zero-division safety.

tasks.title: Question 1 Part 2 Furniture Target MoM Fluctuation & Reconciliation analysis
tasks.description: Implement compute_furniture_target_mom() in src/analytics_engine.py. Filter Sales target for Category == 'Furniture', sort chronologically from April 2018 (Apr-18) through March 2019 (Mar-19). Compute MoM percentage change as ((Target_t - Target_{t-1}) / Target_{t-1}) * 100, setting the baseline month (Apr-18) to None/NaN. Flag months with |MoM % change| >= 15.0% as significant fluctuations. Aggregate actual Furniture sales per month from merged orders, calculate monthly variance (Actual - Target) and achievement percentage ((Actual / Target) * 100), returning List[FurnitureTargetAchievement]. Add unit tests in tests/test_analytics_engine.py verifying chronological ordering, baseline NaN behavior, fluctuation flags, and variance calculations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.4, AC-E3: Pytest in tests/test_analytics_engine.py::test_furniture_target_mom checks chronological sorting from Apr-18 to Mar-19, ensures baseline month Apr-18 has NaN/None for MoM % change, computes ((Target_t - Target_{t-1}) / Target_{t-1}) * 100 for subsequent months, flags months where |MoM| >= 15%, and reconciles actual Furniture sales against monthly targets.

tasks.title: Question 1 Part 3 Regional Performance & Quadrant Classification
tasks.description: Implement compute_top_states_performance() in src/analytics_engine.py. Rank states by distinct order_id volume from List of Orders and select the top 5 states. For each top state, calculate distinct orders, total sales, total profit, average profit per distinct order (Total Profit / Distinct Orders), and overall profit margin percentage ((Total Profit / Total Sales) * 100). Classify each state into strategic performance quadrants (e.g., High Volume / High Margin, High Volume / Low Margin) relative to median volume and margin. Return List[StatePerformance]. Add unit tests in tests/test_analytics_engine.py asserting distinct order counting, metric accuracy, and quadrant assignment.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.5: Pytest in tests/test_analytics_engine.py::test_top_states_performance checks ranking of states by distinct order count, selects top 5 states, computes state total sales, total profit, average profit per distinct order (Total Profit / Distinct Orders), profit margin %, and assigns performance quadrant labels.

tasks.title: Analytical export service and end-to-end CLI runner
tasks.description: Implement ExportService in src/export_service.py to serialize analytical results into structured JSON and CSV files under data/output/ (category_performance.json/csv, furniture_targets.json/csv, state_performance.json/csv). Add integration test verifying end-to-end execution and output file integrity.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-1.1, AC-1.2, AC-1.3, AC-1.4, AC-1.5: Executing `python -m src.main` runs the complete analytical pipeline, outputs styled tabular summaries to the CLI, and writes validated JSON and CSV files to data/output/. tasks.title: Question 2 Jar App UX audit & evaluation model (Strengths & Frictions)
tasks.description: Create src/content/ux_teardown.py containing comprehensive, structured product critiques for Question 2. Document exactly 5 key strengths: 1. Frictionless UPI AutoPay Round-ups, 2. Sub-₹10 Micro-Savings Accessibility, 3. Daily Spin Habit Streaks & Variable Rewards, 4. Real-time Liquidity & Buyback Guarantee, 5. 24K Vault Trust & Verification. Document exactly 5 prioritized UX friction points: 1. AutoPay Failure & Mandate Renewal Transparency, 2. Buy-Sell Spread / GST Perception Gap, 3. Notification Fatigue & Alert Granularity, 4. Asset Class Diversification Friction, 5. Family & Goal-Based Vault Separation. For each item, provide detailed feature/friction description, behavioral psychology and growth mechanics rationale (mental accounting, variable rewards, hyperbolic discounting, cognitive friction), actionable UX/product solution, and primary business impact metric (D30 retention, auto-pay conversion, churn reduction, LTV). Create tests/test_content.py to test completeness.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-2.1: Pytest in tests/test_content.py::test_ux_teardown_completeness checks that exactly 5 effective features and 5 prioritized UX friction points are documented with descriptions, behavioral psychology / growth mechanics rationale, actionable solutions, and primary impact metrics.

tasks.title: Question 3 Fintech Business & Vertical Expansion Strategy
tasks.description: Create src/content/growth_strategy.py containing detailed strategic growth frameworks for Question 3. Detail 5 new business verticals: 1. Gold-Backed Micro-Lending & Instant Credit Line (Jar Cash: overdraft against vaulted gold collateral without liquidating savings), 2. Micro-SIPs in Silver ETFs & Sovereign Gold Bonds (Jar Multi-Asset: automated precious metal diversification), 3. Jar Family Vaults & Child Savings (Intergenerational habit-building with multi-guardian gifting), 4. Gold Leasing / Yield Generation (Jar Earn: 2-3% annual yield via verified jeweller consortiums), 5. Update tests/test_content.py to test completeness.
